name: SparseOcc
definition: A method that learns a neural implicit representation of a shape from a point cloud using binary occupancy fields instead of Signed Distance Fields (SDFs) to stabilize training without requiring dense ground-truth supervision or satisfying the eikonal equation.
summary: SparseOcc is a neural implicit shape method using binary occupancy fields and entropy regularization to stabilize training on sparse or noisy data without requiring SDF constraints.
